pack.name: Cleaning Pack
pack.line: A quote-first site, price sheet, checklists, schedule texts and review asks.

prompts.title: Quote by home size
prompts.summary: A price list by bedrooms, bathrooms and extras, from your time per room and target hourly rate.
prompts.prompt: Build a house cleaning price list. My target per hour [$] per cleaner. Time: per bedroom [min], per bathroom [min], kitchen [min], extras (fridge, oven, windows, baseboards) [min each], drive time average [min]. Give standard, deep and move-out prices for 1 to 4 bedrooms, the extras list, and a text I send with a quote.
prompts.use: Quote in the first reply. People book the first clear price.

prompts.title: Room-by-room checklists
prompts.summary: Checklists for standard, deep and move-out cleans your team can follow.
prompts.prompt: Write room-by-room checklists for [business]: kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, entry. Three levels: standard, deep, move-out (what's added at each). Short lines a cleaner can check off on a phone.
prompts.use: Print one per job, or keep them in your jobs app.

prompts.title: Recurring schedule texts
prompts.summary: Reminder, running late, reschedule and after-clean texts for recurring homes.
prompts.prompt: Write short texts for [business]: the day-before reminder, running late, need to reschedule, after the clean (with a photo note), and the one-month check-in for a recurring home. Under 30 words each.

hooks: Quote in the first text. People book the first clear price.
Room-by-room checklists for a deep clean.
The day-before text for every booking.
Asking for Google reviews without breaking the rules.
Drive time is a cost. Put it in the price.
